item.title: About Monroe County ARES/RACES
item.description:
Monroe County ARES (Amateur Radio Emergency Service) is an organized group of licensed Amateur Radio operators who have volunteered their services to provide emergency communications support during disasters and other emergency situations.

Our Mission

We are dedicated to providing reliable backup communication services when normal communication systems fail or become overloaded. Our volunteers stand ready to assist emergency management agencies, served organizations, and the general public during times of need.

item.title: Contact Us

Meeting Information

item.title: Support Monroe County ARES/RACES
item.description:
Your donations help Monroe County ARES/RACES maintain our capability to provide critical emergency communications services to our community. Even a small contribution can go a long way toward deferring our operational expenses.

How Your Donations Help

Your generous contributions support essential operational costs including:

  • Liability Insurance - Protecting our volunteers while they serve the community
  • Post Office Box Fees - Maintaining our official mailing address
  • Web Page Expenses - Keeping our online presence active and informative

Suggested Donation

We suggest a donation of $10, though any amount is greatly appreciated and helps support our mission.
